nominee.longerDescription: Her account was repeatedly recommended to me on IG because at some point she apparently followed me. A few weeks ago I requested to follow her back, because based on her profile picture (1st pic), she had some potential. Yesterday she finally accepted it, and I have mixed feelings. The 2nd pic is what I think the best one is, the 3rd is what seems to be the worst. The difference is crazy, like going from a 10 to a 5. The better pics most likely have filters and such, it's difficult to say what reality may be.
